mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.role AS user_role FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT c.id AS couple_id, c.groom_id AS groom_id, c.bride_id AS bride_id, me.id AS user_id, me.name AS user_name, me.role AS user_role, partner.id AS partner_user_id, partner.name AS partner_name, partner.role AS partner_role, c.status AS couple_status FROM couple c INNER JOIN `user` me ON me.id = #{userId} AND me.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN `user` partner ON partner.id = CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id WHEN c.bride_id = #{userId} THEN c.groom_id END AND partner.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE c.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) AND c.groom_id IS NOT NULL AND c.bride_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goal g WHERE g.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND g.status IN ('NORMAL', 'PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS wedding_goal_created, CASE WHEN main_goal.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS main_plan_selected, main_goal.id AS main_goal_id, main_goal.status AS main_goal_status, DATE_FORMAT(main_goal.wedding_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS wedding_date, NULLIF(TRIM(main_goal.region), '') AS region FROM ( SELECT 1 AS checklist_base ) base LEFT JOIN goal main_goal ON main_goal.id = ( SELECT g.id FROM goal g WHERE g.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND g.is_main = TRUE AND g.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

SELECT g.total_budget AS total_budget_amount, COALESCE(total_saving.total_saved_amount, 0) AS total_saved_amount, COALESCE(personal_saving.personal_saved_amount, 0) AS personal_saved_amount, CAST(FLOOR( g.total_budget * CASE WHEN #{userId} = #{groomId} THEN g.groom_ratio ELSE g.bride_ratio END / 100 ) AS SIGNED) AS personal_target_amount, COALESCE(expense.wedding_expense_amount, 0) AS wedding_expense_amount, GREATEST( g.total_budget - COALESCE(total_saving.total_saved_amount, 0), 0 ) AS remaining_wedding_fund_amount, DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS base_date FROM goal g LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.amount), 0) AS total_saved_amount FROM account a INNER JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND ar.type = 'SAVING' ) total_saving ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.amount), 0) AS personal_saved_amount FROM account a INNER JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND ar.type = 'SAVING' ) personal_saving ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(account_expense.account_expense_amount, 0) + COALESCE(card_expense.card_expense_amount, 0) AS wedding_expense_amount FROM ( SELECT 1 AS expense_base ) expense_base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.amount), 0) AS account_expense_amount FROM account a INNER JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND ar.type = 'EXPENSE' AND ar.category = '결혼비용' ) account_expense ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cr.amount), 0) AS card_expense_amount FROM card cd INNER JOIN card_record cr ON cr.card_id = cd.id WHERE cd.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND cr.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cr.category = '결혼비용' ) card_expense ON 1 = 1 ) expense ON 1 = 1 WHERE g.id = #{goalId}

SELECT ws.region AS region, CASE ws.region WHEN '서울(강남)' THEN '서울' WHEN '서울(강남외)' THEN '서울' WHEN '경기도' THEN '경기' ELSE ws.region END AS display_region, SUM(ws.mid_50) AS balanced_amount FROM wedding_statistics ws WHERE ws.category IN ('예식장', '스튜디오', '드레스', '메이크업') AND ws.region IN ('서울(강남)', '경기도', '인천', '부산', '대구', '광주', '대전') GROUP BY ws.region HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ws.category) = 4 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ws.region = '서울(강남)' THEN 1 WHEN ws.region = '경기도' THEN 2 WHEN ws.region = '인천' THEN 3 WHEN ws.region = '부산' THEN 4 WHEN ws.region = '대구' THEN 5 WHEN ws.region = '광주' THEN 6 WHEN ws.region = '대전' THEN 7 ELSE 99 END, SUM(ws.mid_50) DESC, ws.region ASC LIMIT 7
SELECT n.type AS alert_type, n.title AS title, n.content AS message, n.created_at AS created_at FROM notification n WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT 1
